items.title: 天文台預料本港今晚沿岸水位較正常稍高 部分低窪地區或輕微水浸
items.summary: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，指受到天文大潮及東北季候風共同影響，預料本港今晚沿岸水位會較正常稍高，部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸。 編輯：盧曉珊
items.titleEn: The Observatory predicts that Hong Kong's coastline will be slightly higher tonight, with some areas low or slightly submerged.
items.summaryEn: The National Weather Service has issued a special weather advisory, indicating that due to the combined effects of the meteorological tides and the northeastern climatic winds, it is expected that the coastal water level will be slightly higher than normal tonight and that some low-lying areas may be slightly submerged. Editor: Luciushan

items.summaryEn: Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving airline passengers at the airport, collecting about 19 kilograms of suspected marijuana, estimated to be worth about 4 million yuan. items.title: 有議員關注政府會否在壓抑及監督港燈基本電價「下大苦功」
items.summary: 兩間電力公司明年1月將加電費，中電按年加1.8%，港燈按年加7.9%。 在立法會一個委員會上，工聯會鄧家彪問到，政府會否在壓抑和監督港燈的基本電價方面「下大苦功」。 環境及生態局局長謝展寰回應說，政府一直有努力壓抑兩電電價、審核帳目以及結構性改變電力市場，強調政府的決心是無容置疑，不會為任何電力公司辯護，但客觀事實而言，港燈的電力市場正在萎縮，導致即使開支沒特別增加，基本電價也會上升。…
items.titleEn: Some lawmakers are concerned about whether the government will "downsize" the basic electricity prices of port lights by suppressing and monitoring them.
items.summaryEn: In January, the two electricity companies will increase their electricity bills by 1.8% a year, while port lights will increase by 7.9% a year. In a committee of the Legislative Assembly, union officials questioned whether the government would "do anything" to suppress and control basic electricity prices for harbor lights. In response to the government's efforts to suppress electricity prices, censorship accounts and structural changes to the electricity market, the Environment and Ecology Bureau Directorate thanked the government for its determination to not advocate for any electricity company, but the objective fact is that the market for electricity in port lights is shrinking, causing basic electricity prices to rise even if they do not increase significantly. items.titleEn: Chen Mubo: Hong Kong can help British companies bring technology to the mainland and advocate for Hong Kong-based technology
items.summaryEn: Finance Minister Chen Mabo said that Hong Kong as a "super connector" can help British companies bring technology to the mainland, and it can also help domestic companies in the United Kingdom to finance, develop and test new technologies in Hong Kong. items.title: 伊利沙伯醫院4名女病人感染甲型流感
items.summary: 伊利沙伯醫院一個內科女病房自上星期五起，先後有4名病人，年齡由60歲至75歲出現發燒或呼吸道感染徵狀。院方已為病人進行所需病毒測試，結果均對甲型流感病毒呈陽性反應。 4名病人現時於本院接受隔離治療。其中一名病人因自身疾病而情況危殆，其餘三名病人目前情況穩定。院方已根據既定指引加強感染控制措施，並會繼續緊密監察該病房病人的健康情況。 院方已將有關個案呈報醫管局總辦事處及衞生防護中心跟進。 編輯：李俊傑
items.titleEn: Four female patients at Elizabeth Hospital are infected with influenza A
items.summaryEn: In a nursing home at Elizabeth Hospital, four patients aged 60 to 75 years have had fever or symptoms of respiratory infections since Friday. The hospital has conducted the necessary virus tests on patients, and all of them have tested positive for influenza A virus. Four patients are currently being treated in isolation at the hospital. One of the patients is in deteriorating condition due to his own illness, while the other three patients are currently stable. The hospital has already stepped up its infection control measures in line with established guidelines and will continue to closely monitor the health status of patients in the hospital. The hospital has reported the case to the General Office of the Medical Administration and the Centre for the Prevention of Tuberculosis. Editor: Li Jun-jeong
